summary: Intermittent network_cli failures with truncated output or 'operation requires privilege escalation' can come from prompt mismatch; tune ansible_buffer_read_timeout (default 0.2s) per task or buffer_read_timeout globally, or 0 to disable.
questions: Why do I get truncated output from network_cli sometimes?
How do I fix intermittent operation requires privilege escalation errors?

answer_card.title: Fix intermittent network_cli failures
answer_card.answer_md:
Since 2.7.1 a buffer read timer (default 0.2 s) helps match prompts and capture full output. Raise it per task:
```yaml
- cisco.ios.ios_facts:
    gather_subset: all
  vars:
    ansible_buffer_read_timeout: 2
```
or globally:
```ini
[persistent_connection]
buffer_read_timeout = 2
```
Set `0` to disable the delay.
